title: fix(android): don't block on the locale broadcast

target.summary: Under heavy broadcast queue churn, the detached locale broadcast receiver can take longer to update persist.sys.locale than the polling budget in awaitLocaleApplied. setDeviceLocale exhausts its attempts and prematurely returns SET_LOCALE_RESULT_UPDATE_CONFIGURATION_FAILED for locale changes that actually succeed.
notes: faulty polling loop that exhausts its verification budget before late-running broadcast updates take effect
call site in setDeviceLocale that retries the broadcast and prematurely returns SET_LOCALE_RESULT_UPDATE_CONFIGURATION_FAILED
definition of LocaleRetryPolicy which defines the polling budget without an adequate grace period
